name: Tool — Fabric IQ (1P MCP)
description: **Fabric IQ** is a proposed first-party MCP server that would expose Microsoft Fabric data as a tool. Distinct from the `tool-fabric-data-agent` card (that one uses a Fabric Data Agent, not an MCP endpoint).
notes: Fabric IQ is **not on the official BYOM-supported tools list** (only Foundry IQ, SharePoint Grounding, and Fabric Data Agent are listed as 1P MCP servers — see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations). No probe is meaningful until Microsoft publishes the URL.
